title: Saturn Super Vol. 9 Furoku CD-ROM
native_title: サターン・スーパー Ｖｏｌ．９ 付録ＣＤ‐ＲＯＭ
overview:
Cover disc packed with the ninth issue of the Japanese magazine Saturn Super. It contains playable demos of these Saturn games:
- Princess Crown
- Lulu
- Shinrei Jusatsushi Taroumaru
- Tryrush Deppy
- Digital Pinball: Necronomicon Revelations
- Gambler Jiko Chuushinha: Tokyo Mahjongland
